posts.title: Faça Pausas Ativas e Alongue-se
posts.excerpt: Levante-se a cada hora para caminhar ou alongar. Isso melhora a circulação, reduz a tensão muscular e renova a energia para suas tarefas.

posts.title: Take Active Breaks and Stretch
posts.excerpt: Stand up every hour to walk or stretch. This improves circulation, reduces muscle tension, and renews energy for your tasks.

posts.title: Hydrate and Eat Mindfully
posts.excerpt: Drink water regularly and choose healthy snacks. Avoid processed foods to maintain your focus and well-being throughout the day.
